items.name: Chill Out Trondheim 2025
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Chill Out Trondheim 2025! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 50kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025#51927-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Chill Out Trondheim 2025! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 50 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ChillOutTrondheim2025#51927-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

Após essa data, só será possível a inscrição no dia do campeonato, caso haja vagas remanescentes. * Fique atento aos horários de credenciamento na aba [Cronograma](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelhoIILondrina2024#competition-schedule). Chegue com antecedência para fazer seu credenciamento antes de qualquer modalidade que você for participar. * Todos os competidores devem apresentar documento válido com foto no credenciamento. * É necessário que todos os participantes leiam o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição. * O cubo com o qual você vai competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele. Caso contrário, o cubo pode não ser aceito para a competição. * Caso seja seu primeiro campeonato, assista [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE). * Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal. * Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. Mande suas dúvidas para a [organização](diego.quintanilha@hotmail.com) e faremos o melhor possível para ajudar. Sempre há espaço para novos competidores! * Divirta-se! --- ##### 🇺🇸 **Pé Vermelho II** is the second edition of our **open charity** competition. Here are some instructions and reminders for those who wish to participate: * All information regarding registration can be found in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelhoIILondrina2024/register) tab. * Registration closes on **12/07/2024**, or whenever the **limit of 70 competitors** is reached. After that, it will only be possible to register in the day of the competition, if there are still vacancies. * Pay attention to check-in times in the [Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelhoIILondrina2024#competition-schedule) tab. Please arrive early in order to check-in before participating in any event. * All competitors must present a valid document at the check-in. * All participants must read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. * The cube with which you will compete must be in good condition, so take good care of it. Otherwise, your cube may not be approved for the competition. * If this is your first competition, watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE). * There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian. * If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. items.information: ### **IMPORTANTE** Es obligatorio revisar [el reglamento de la WCA.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) para comprender las normas y procedimientos que se realizaran en el torneo. * Revisar la pestaña [Registro](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OpenChristmasCubeHuancayo2024#50386-registro-registration) para conocer el método de registro. * Revisar la pestaña [Horario](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OpenChristmasCubeHuancayo2024#competition-schedule) para conocer el cronograma del torneo. * Para **Registrarte** al torneo hacer click en [Registrarse](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OpenChristmasCubeHuancayo2024/register) * Asimismo, se les recomienda revisar estos videos para tener una noción mas clara de como se llevará a cabo el torneo. items.information: **(Português) Brasileiro** É com grande alegria que anunciamos mais um Capivara! Desde o ano passados, estamos trabalhando com doações para fins filantrópicos, assim, além de nos divertirmos, também ajudamos a fazer um mundo melhor. Estamos trabalhando em conjunto com o [LEO e Lions](https://www.lionsclubs.org/) para arrecadar brinquedos e alimentos para crianças carentes, então todo o lucro da competição será revertido para essa campanha. Além disso, se você quiser fazer uma doação no dia, também será muito bem-vinda. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=hfp2rKaN8jHPI_RL). É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, que podem ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/). Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'. **English** It is in great excitement that we announce a new Capivara! Starting last year, we are working with donations for philanthropic purposes, therefore, in addition to having fun, we can also help make a better world. We are working together with [LEO and Lions](https://www.lionsclubs.org/) to collect toys and food to children in need, so all profit from the competition will be directed to that campaign. Besides that, if you would like to give a donation on the spot, it will also be very welcome. Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://youtu.be/dZQiw5v8Bm0?si=6Yf5Zun_nlTfECTy). It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

items.information: [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce Cubing Bash Bloemfontein 2024! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** pay for your ticket to confirm your entry. Please see **Registration Requirements** below for instructions and when registration opens. ### All New Competitors If this is your first time competing, or the first time your child or ward is competing, please ensure to bring with **ID (card, book, passport, birth certificate)** so that we can verify that the name is spelled correctly, the Date of Birth is correct, and the Nationality is correct. Please also ensure you have all the puzzles you need to compete - we do not supply puzzles for competitors. You are welcome to ask other competitors if you can borrow their puzzle for a certain event, but there is no guarantee. If you need a puzzle before the competition, check out www.speedcubes.co.za, to order your puzzles before the comp! A huge thanks to [Speedcubes](www.speedcubes.co.za) for sponsoring this competition! Please see the Sponsors tab for more information, and make sure to support the Speedcubes shop! ![Speedcubes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5NDUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--f899ecbbd498c3dd38ea30276772dcc02470011a/NEW_SPEEDCUBE_LOGO_BLACK.webp)

items.information: ### 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대기자 명단에 등록됩니다. ### 신청 후 [참가자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/52/competitors)에서 본인의 이름을 확인하십시오. 이름이 보이지 않을 경우 [대기자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/52/waitlist)을 확인하여 주십시오. ### 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [WCA 규정 및 타이머 사용 안내 영상](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ ### Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, due to the first-come first-served basis for registration, you might be put on the waitlist. ### After registration, please check your name on the [competitor list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/52/competitors). Please check the [wait list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/52/waitlist) if your name is not on the competitor list. ### Please be sure to check the emails sent by the organizers. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1) if you are not familiar with the official WCA competition.

Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). Please see tabs for more information about the competition. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ## [FR] ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information: We're excited to welcome competitors back to Bozeman for another fun day of speedcubing! Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa0Y3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--da1436f51b6bdf99f61924b5ef7f58cd5d26107f/Coralito%20(1).png) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al Coralito Bahía De Banderas 2024, la tercera competencia oficial en el hermoso estado de Nayarit y primera en el municipio de Bahía de Banderas!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de La Cruz de Huanacaxtle los días 9 y 10 de noviembre de 2024. El Coralito Bahía De Banderas 2024 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de modalidades y categorías. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. Esta competencia es organizada por el Team Nayarit y la comunidad Vallarta Speed. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. ###### English Welcome to Coralito Bahía De Banderas 2024, the third official competition in the beautiful state of Nayarit and the first one in the municipality of Bahía de Banderas! This exciting and fast-paced event will take place in the city of La Cruz de Huanacaxtle on November 9th and 10th, 2024. The Coralito Bahía De Banderas will bring together cubers from all over the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events and categories. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned pro, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun. This competition is organized by Team Nayarit and the Vallarta Speed community. This competition is recognized as a World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

items.information: Els socis de l'ACSC reben un descompte del 15% després de la competició. Pots fer-te soci de l'ACSC [aquí](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat). Aquesta competició no té una categoria principal. El guanyador de la competició es decidirà mitjançant el “Sum of Ranks”. Això consisteix a sumar totes les posicions en què ha quedat un competidor a totes les categories, i qui obtingui el nombre més baix serà qui millor ha actuat en tot el llarg de la competició i, per tant, el guanyador. ​ Los socios de la ACSC reciben un descuento del 15% después de la competición. Puedes hacerte socio de la ACSC [aquí](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat). Esta competición no tiene una categoría principal. El ganador de la competición se decidirá mediante “Sum of Ranks”. Esto consiste a sumar todas las posiciones en que ha quedado un competidor en todas las categorías, y quién obtenga el número más bajo será quien mejor ha actuado a lo largo de toda la competición y, por tanto, el ganador. ​ The ACSC members will receive a 15% discount after the end of the competition. You can become a member of the ACSC [here](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat). This competition does not have a main event. The winner of the competition will be decided through the “Sum of Ranks”. This consists of adding all the positions in which a competitor has remained in all categories, and the one who obtain the lowest number will be the one who has performed best throughout the competition and, therefore, the winner.

items.name: Rubik's UK Championship 2024
items.information: ## Welcome to Rubik's UK Championship 2024! ### This year's UK National Championship! #### Please read ALL tabs before registering. ##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Guests, Spectators, and Media](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2024#41928-guests-spectators-and-media) tab. **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Rubik's UK Championship 2024, you'll receive a Rubik's UK Championship 2024 T-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size.** **Guests:** A fee of £5 for a guest wristband will be due for all spectators and competitors' guests. They will be available on the door, payable via cash or card. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** Please note that the guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only. **Newcomers:** Unfortunately, **this competition is not open to first-time competitors**. If you have not been to a competition before but would like to attend this one, you must attend another competition first. You can see all upcoming UK competitions [here](https://wca.ukca.org). **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2024#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by October 22nd you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. Please note that **the only qualification for 2x2, 3x3, Pyraminx, and Skewb is to have any average in the event.** **Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round, we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1: 6 UK competitors; 3x3: 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors. **Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionshipFMC2024). The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Rubik's UK Championship 2024. **Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbng5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--153ecb54fb75b7956c0701cb174dca72201b0444/image.png)

items.information: # 본 대회는 3x3x3 종목이 없습니다. ### 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대기자 명단에 등록됩니다. ### 신청 후 [참가자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/51/competitors)에서 본인의 이름을 확인하십시오. 이름이 보이지 않을 경우 [대기자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/51/waitlist)을 확인하여 주십시오. ### 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [WCA 규정 및 타이머 사용 안내 영상](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ # There is no 3x3x3 event at this competition. ### Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, due to the first-come first-served basis for registration, you might be put on the waitlist. ### After registration, please check your name on the [competitor list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/51/competitors). Please check the [wait list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/51/waitlist) if your name is not on the competitor list. ### Please be sure to check the emails sent by the organizers. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1) if you are not familiar with the official WCA competition.

items.name: Kalvskinnet Kubing 2024
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Kalvskinnet Kubing 2024! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 50kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2024#48216-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Kalvskinnet Kubing 2024! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 50 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2024/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2024#48216-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

items.information: 24 Hours Warm Up in Astana 2024 – Астанадағы 24 сағаттық ашық жарыс. Бұл жарыстар 24 сағат үзіліссіз өтеді, сондықтан олар жас және жаңа қатысушыларға ұсынылмайды. Кез келген пәндер санына қатысу мүмкіндігімен базалық жарна 3000 теңгені құрайды. 1 кез келген пәнге тіркелу кезінде тіркеу жарнасы 1000 теңгені құрайды. Бұл жарыстарды QBERS TEAM ұйымдастырады. 24 Hours Warm Up in Astana 2024 - это первые открытые 24-х часовые соревнования в Астане. Данные соревнования будут проходить без перерывов 24 часа, следовательно не рекомендуются для юных и новых участников. Базовый взнос с возможностью участия в любом количестве дисциплин составляет 3000 тенге. При регистрации на 1 любую дисциплину регистрационный взнос составит 1000 тенге. Данные сореванования организованы QBERS TEAM. 24 Hours Warm Up in Astana 2024 is the first open 24-hour competition in Astana. These competitions will take place without breaks for 24 hours, therefore they are not recommended for young and new participants. The base registration fee for any number of events is 3000 tenge. If you're participating in 1 event only, the registration fee is 1000 tenge. These competition is organized by QBERS TEAM.

items.information: (SRB) Belgrade Open 2024 je dvadeset i drugo po redu takmičenje koje se održava u Srbiji. Svako može da se takmiči, nezavisno od njihove nacionalnosti ili godina, ali moraju biti upoznati sa WCA Regulacijama i moraju da ih pročitaju pre takmičenja. **Cena kotizacije za ovo takmičenje zavisi od toga koje discipline slažete. Ukoliko se takmičite samo u 3x3 i 2x2 kocki cena kotizacije iznosi 1,000RSD , ali ukoliko se takmičite u više disciplina plaćate punu cenu od 2,000RSD. Ovo nije standardna praksa i ovo pravilo važi samo za ovo takmičenje.** ------------------------ (ENG) Belgrade Open 2024 is the 22nd speedcubing competition in a row that's being held in Serbia. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations and read them before the competition. **Registration fee for this competition depends on which events you are competing in. If you are competing in only 3x3 and 2x2 cubes, you will pay 1,000RSD, but if you are competing in more events, you will pay the full amount of 2,000RSD. This is not a standard practice, and this rule applies only to this competition.**

items.information: ### [FR] Il s'agit du tout premier championnat québécois organisé par [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org). 13 épreuves officielles de la WCA (toutes les épreuves sauf 4x4x4 à l'aveugle, 5x5x5 à l'aveugle ,3x3x3 Multi-Blind, et 3x3x3 Fewest Moves) seront organisées lors de cette compétition. **Les étudiants de l'ÉTS peuvent s'inscrire sans frais**. Si vous êtes étudiant de l'ÉTS, inscrivez votre courriel finissant par estmtl.net dans la zone des commentaires lorsque vous vous inscrivez puis **ne payez pas les frais d'inscription**. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. --- ### [EN] This is the first-ever Quebec Championship organized by [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org). 13 official WCA events (all events except 4x4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5x5 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, and 3x3x3 Fewest Moves) will be held at this competition. **ETS students may compete for free**. If you are an ETS student, write your email address ending with etsmtl.net in the registration comments and submit your registration **and do not pay the registration fees**. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Sandnes Open 2024
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Sandnes Open 2024! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 170kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Sandnes Open 2024! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 170 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2024/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition.

items.information: **REGISTRO** A participação nesta competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: 1. Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$ 35 e o pagamento deverá ser feito via PIX para a chave planeta.rio.open@gmail.com. O comprovante de pagamento deverá ser enviado para o mesmo email; 2. Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Prestar atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites; 3. Preencher o seguinte [formulário](https://forms.gle/CKRxrhXte6JPtWmq5) para facilitar o controle dos nomes dos competidores e acompanhantes por parte da equipe do Planetário envolvida com a organização; 4. Para obterem a entrada e permanência na competição, os **acompanhantes** deverão adquirir os ingressos na bilheteria do Planetário. Cada competidor terá direito a 2 acompanhantes grátis e mais dois pagando meia entrada (R$10), isso caso a inscrição seja realizada até dia 5 de setembro. Os demais acompanhantes, se houver, deverão pagar o valor inteiro do ingresso (R$20) para entrada. **Esta taxa é aplicada somente aos acompanhantes e deverá ser paga apenas nos dias da competição, não devendo ser feita junto a transferência PIX para o pagamento da inscrição**; 5. Para informações adicionais, verifique o site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do email planeta.rio.open@gmail.com, bem como o delegado por meio do email gmello@worldcubeassociation.org ou isoares@worldcubeassociation.org; 6. Favor ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição. **REGISTRATION** The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: 1. Register through the WCA website. The registration costs R$35 and must be paid via PIX transfer to planeta.rio.open@gmail.com. Proof of payment must be sent to the same email address; 2. Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind; 3. Fill in the following [form](https://forms.gle/CKRxrhXte6JPtWmq5) to help keep track of competitor and guest names by the Planetarium team involved with the organization; 4. To gain entry and stay in the competition, **companions** must purchase tickets at the Planetarium box office. Each competitor will be entitled to 2 free companions and two more for half price (R$10), if registration is completed by September 5th. Other companions, if any, must pay the entire ticket price (R$20) for entry. **This fee is only applied to companions and must only be paid on the days of the competition, and must not be made together with the PIX transfer to pay for registration**; 5. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (planeta.rio.open@gmail.com), or the delegate ( gmello@worldcubeassociation.org or isoares@worldcubeassociation.org); 6. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## [EN] ### Registration Reminders Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most four (4) events**. You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). If you are a new competitor, this video expains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY). Please see tabs for more information about the competition. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ## [FR] ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Comme il s'agit là d'une compétition de type "favoris", **vous pouvez choisir au maximum quatre (4) épreuves**. Vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess.

items.name: Örebro Minxfest 2024
items.information: Välkomna till en tävling i Örebro med ett fokus på sidogrenar! Notera att varken 3x3 eller de andra mest populära grenarna hålls på denna tävling. Självklart är ändå alla varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Tre försök av FMC kommer att hållas under morgonen fram till lunch, så om du inte deltar i FMC behöver du inte komma till lokalen förrens lunch. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to a competition in Örebro with a focus on side events! Please note that neither 3x3 nor the other most popular events will be held at this competition. Regardless, everyone is of course welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. Three attempts of FMC will be held during the morning up until lunch, so you don't have to come to the venue before lunch if you're not participating in FMC. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

Un torneo en fechas patrias con puente, en una de las mejores ciudades para dar el grito de independencia, un mix de **9 categorías**, y darte la oportunidad de disfrutar del cierre de temporada de los deliciosos Chiles en Nogada. ​ Puebla, la tierra del Chile en Nogada, te invita a divertirte y disfrutar de este próximo torneo. ​ Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del **"INSTITUTO D'AMICIS S.C"**. ​ D'Amicis Puebla 2024 es una competencia oficial de la WCA por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/). ​ ##### English ​ **¡Welcome to D'Amicis Puebla 2024!** ​ Close your eyes and imagine... A tournament on holidays, in one of the best cities to celebrate "El Grito", a mix of **9 categories**, and the chance to enjoy the end of the season for the delicious Chiles en Nogada. ​ Puebla, the land of Chile en Nogada, invites you to have fun and enjoy this upcoming tournament. ​ This competition is possible thanks to the support of the **"INSTITUTO D'AMICIS S.C"**. ​ D'Amicis Puebla 2024 is a WCA official competition, hence all participants should be familiar with the [Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations).

items.information: Der Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown ist Teil des Swisscubing Cup 2024. Dieser besteht aus mehreren Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. Jeder ist willkommen, unabhängig davon ob Interesse besteht, am Swisscubing Cup Finale teilzunehmen. **Punkte für die Qualifikation für das Swisscubing Cup 2024 Finale können bei dieser Competition nur in den folgenden Disziplinen gesammelt werden: 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** Alle anderen Disziplinen an dieser Competition sind nicht Teil des Swisscubing Cups. ______________________________________________________________________________________________ The Swisscubing Cup Mental Breakdown is part of the Swisscubing Cup 2024, made of multiple competitions during the whole year. Everyone is welcome to compete, regardless of whether they are interested in taking part in the Swisscubing Cup final. **Points for qualifying for the Swisscubing Cup 2024 Finals can only be collected at this competition in the following events: 4-Blind, 5-Blind, Multiblind, FMC.** All other events at this competition are not part of the Swisscubing Cup.

items.name: Svealandsmästerskapet 2024
items.information: Välkomna till Svealandsmästerskapet 2024! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Alla som vill är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett tidigare erfarenhet eller var i världen du bor. Notera dock att det endast är deltagare som bor i Svealand som kan vinna titlar och priser på Svealandsmästerskapet, läs mer om detta under fliken "[Regionala Mästerskap](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2024#43353-regionala-masterskap-2024-regional-championships-2024)". ----- Welcome to Svealandsmästerskapet 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Anyone who wants is warmly welcome to participate, regardless of previous experience or where in the world you live. Note, however, that only competitors who live in Svealand can win titles and prizes at the Svealand Championship, read more about this under the tab "[Regional Championships](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Svealandsmasterskapet2024#43353-regionala-masterskap-2024-regional-championships-2024)". items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events.

items.name: Matatipac Open 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBckdEIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f5052380d4840da25b42fdc99bf608f4ab05e628/Matatipac%20Open%202024%20(1).png) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al **Matatipac Open 2024**! Esta emocionante y dinámica competencia se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic el sábado 17 y domingo 18 de agosto de 2024. El Matatipac Open 2024 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de rompecabezas tridimensionales, principalmente eventos no cúbicos. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. La competencia incluirá una ronda de Face-Turning Octahedron (FTO), un evento no oficial que promete ser muy emocionante. Además, esta competencia está reconocida oficialmente por la Asociación Mundial del Cubo (WCA). Por lo tanto, es importante que todos los competidores estén familiarizados con el reglamento de la WCA antes de la competencia. ###### English Welcome to the **Matatipac Open 2024**! This exciting and dynamic competition will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, August 17, and Sunday, August 18, 2024. The Matatipac Open 2024 will bring together cubers from all over the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of three-dimensional puzzles, primarily non-cubic events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun. The competition will include a round of Face-Turning Octahedron (FTO), an unofficial event that promises to be very exciting. Additionally, this competition is officially recognized by the World Cube Association (WCA). Therefore, it is important for all competitors to be familiar with the WCA regulations before the competition.

items.name: BC Championship 2024
items.information: After hosting the Canadian Championship in July 2023, Speedcubing Canada welcomes you back for BC's first Provincial Championship! Note: While everybody is welcome to attend and compete, only BC residents will be eligible for the title of **BC Champion**. For more information, please check out the [Championship Eligibility tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BCChampionship2024#41375-championship-eligibility). **Please review all of the tabs listed on this website**. You only need to show up for the events that you're competing in - but we encourage you to show up for longer. So, if you are not competing in any events being held on Friday, then you don't need to show up until Saturday. Note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, so please be ready for each event/round **about 30 minutes in advance**, just in-case. To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). Unsubscribe at any time. [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdWh2IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f989abe60a5b9303f42de97dee94ad812338f4b3/image.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/en) **Notice of filming and photography**: Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. Masks will be optional. Do not attend if you feel/are sick.

items.name: Norwegian Championship 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaHFKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c60c36a3fbfb1c2f2d10ce4665856be2a51bbe19/Artboard%201.png) ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Norgesmesterskapet i Kubing 2024, for første gang holdt i Sandnes! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta, uavhengig av nasjonalitet. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta på NM. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39270-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). ### Staffing Vi kommer til å trenge frivillige som kan bidra med ulike oppgaver under arrangementet. De som bidrar på dette teamet vil få ulike goder, blant annet refundert registreringsavgift. Les [Staffing-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39280-staffing) for mer info. --- ## 🇬🇧 Information Welcome to the Norwegian Cubing Championship of 2024, held in Sandnes for the first time. The competition is open to all who wish to compete regardless of nationality. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete in the Norwegian Championship. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39270-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab. ### Staffing We are going to need volunteers to help with different tasks during the competition. Those who chose to be a part of this team will get perks such as a refunded registration fee. Read the [Staffing](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NorwegianChampionship2024#39280-staffing) tab for more info.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdE4rIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e2c1c170bf8e893e2b0e882cf48112c0b8251176/CARTEL%20GO%202024.png) **Español** **¡Bienvenidos a Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2024!** La Guelaguetza es mucho más que una simple festividad, es el corazón mismo de la cultura oaxaqueña. Representa la esencia de la generosidad, la solidaridad y la comunidad que caracteriza a este hermoso estado de México. En la Guelaguetza, las personas se reúnen para compartir, celebrar y fortalecer los lazos que los unen como comunidad. Y ¿qué mejor manera de expresar esta conexión que a través de los cubos Rubik? Al resolver este rompecabezas, no solo estamos demostrando habilidad y destreza, sino también la capacidad de unirnos en un desafío común, sin importar nuestro origen o cultura. ¡No te pierdas la oportunidad de ser parte de este encuentro único, donde los cubos se convierten en símbolos de conexión y celebración! ¡Te esperamos en la "Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2024"! **Inglés** **Welcome to Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2024!** Guelaguetza is much more than just a festival; it's the very heart of Oaxacan culture. It represents the essence of generosity, solidarity, and community that characterize this beautiful state of Mexico. During Guelaguetza, people come together to share, celebrate, and strengthen the bonds that unite them as a community. And what better way to express this connection than through Rubik's Cubes? By solving this puzzle, we're not only showcasing skill and dexterity but also the ability to come together in a common challenge, regardless of our background or culture. Don't miss the chance to be part of this unique gathering, where Rubik's Cubes become symbols of connection and celebration! We look forward to seeing you at "Guelaguetza Oaxaca 2024"!

items.information: ## SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them. ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## SPONSORSHIP A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za/) who are sponsoring the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. ## NOTICE OF FILMING: Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending. ## VENUE Oppi Dak is situated inside the Gateway Corner Centre. It is located on the first floor right above Liquor City and can be accessed via the stairs or the lift. The venue will provide a variety of food, snacks and drinks on both days and also offer card and cash payment options. On Sunday they also serve a separate Buffet Lunch which you are more than welcome to take part in. Bathroom facilities are available inside the venue, and the Centre itself also provides alternative bathrooms outside of the venue itself. #### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

items.information: Chào mừng các bạn đến với giải đấu vô địch quốc gia Vietnam Championship 2024! Giải Vietnam Championship lần này sẽ có toàn bộ các bộ môn thi đấu, với nhiều môn thi đấu có từ 2 đến 4 vòng. Xem thêm thông tin tại các tab. # Điều kiện tham dự thi Giải bịt mắt 4x4x4 và Giải bịt mắt 5x5x5 Các thí sinh tham dự các nội dung **Giải bịt mắt 4x4x4 và Giải bịt mắt 5x5x5** phải đạt điều kiện sau: * Thí sinh phải có **ít nhất một lượt** Giải bịt mắt 3x3x3 thành công. * Kết quả Giải bịt mắt 3x3x3 tốt nhất của thí sinh đạt **Top 20** trong số các thí sinh đã đăng ký thi nội dung tương ứng. Các thí sinh không đạt những điều kiện này sẽ **không được tham dự thi** các nội dung tương ứng và sẽ được hoàn 100% lệ phí các môn này (nếu đã nộp). # Thông cáo về quay phim chụp ảnh Ban tổ chức và/hoặc các hãng truyền thông tại giải đấu có thể sẽ quay phim, chụp ảnh làm tư liệu về giải đấu. Bằng cách có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu, **bạn công nhận rằng bạn đã được thông báo về việc quay phim, chụp ảnh tại giải đấu, và hiểu rõ rằng tư liệu hình ảnh này sẽ được sử dụng cho mọi mục đích cần thiết của Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan. Bạn đồng thời cũng đồng ý cho phép Hiệp hội Rubik Việt Nam, các tổ chức đại diện và các đối tác, nhà tài trợ liên quan toàn quyền vĩnh viễn sử dụng những hình ảnh có diện mạo và/hoặc giọng nói của bạn cho mọi mục đích cần thiết.** Nếu bạn không đồng ý với các điều khoản trên, xin vui lòng không có mặt tại hội trường giải đấu. ________________________________________________________________ We warmly welcome you to Vietnam Championships 2024! This year's Vietnam Championship will offer all events, many of which will be offering 2 to 4 rounds. Refer to the tabs for more information. # Qualification Criteria for 4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded Competitors in **4x4x4 Blindfolded and 5x5x5 Blindfolded** must meet the following qualification criteria: * The competitor must have **at least one** successful 3x3x3 Blindfolded result. * The competitor's best 3x3x3 Blindfolded result must be within the **Top 20** of all registered competitors of the respective event. Competitors who fail to meet these criteria will **not be allowed to compete in the respective event** and will receive a full refund of any event fees for the events (if already paid). # Notice on Filming and Photography The organizers and/or present media companies may perform filming and photography at the competition for usage as photographic material of the competition. By being present at the competition premises, **you acknowledge that you have been duly informed of any filming and photography that might take place at the competition, and fully acknowledge that the material may be used for any and all necessary purposes by the Vietnam Cube Association (VNCA) and its representatives, partners and affiliated sponsors. You also grant full, perpetual consent for VNCA and its representatives, partners and affiliated sponsors to use video and photographic material that contains your likeness and/or voice for any and all necessary purposes.** If you do not agree with the above terms, please do not be present at the competition premises. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBclJwIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2901c91547887dda589a7979741476bc143c0896/vietnamcube%20(1).png)

items.name: 24 Hours in Åker 2024
items.information: Varmt välkomna till denna 24-timmarstävling i Åkers Styckebruk! Precis som vanligt så är alla som önskar varmt välkomna att delta, men vi vill ändå utfärda en kraftig varning kring att tävlingen pågår nonstop i just 24 timmar, och har ett väldigt speciellt koncept. Därför passar tävlingen sannolikt inte varken nya eller yngre deltagare särskilt bra. Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information, särskilt fliken [koncept](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/24HoursinAker2024#43667-koncept-concept). ----- A warm welcome to this 24-hour competition in Åkers Styckebruk! Just as usual, everyone who wishes is warmly welcome to participate, but we still want to issue a strong warning that the competition runs non-stop for exactly 24 hours, and has a very special concept. Therefore, the competition probably does not suit neither new or younger participants very well. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdlo2IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--0981036a30347f039f2f8369d2f3c11a6625373f/LOGO_TORNEO_LOS_FUERTES.jpg) ##### Español **¡Bienvenidos a Los Fuertes Puebla 2024!** Puebla, la ciudad donde la grandeza se encuentra entre volcanes, se está preparando para recibirte en un próximo torneo y poner a prueba tus habilidades. ¿Qué tan fuerte podrás llegar? ¡Esto es un reto contra ti mismo! *¿Sabías que...?* El triángulo se considera la figura geométrica más fuerte. Cuando piensas en los volcanes, ¿qué categoría viene a tu mente? Así es como Pyraminx representa diferentes aspectos de este torneo. Estamos seguros que no esperabas tremendas referencias con el nombre, el lugar y nuestra categoría principal. Y aún hay más, ¡échale un vistazo a los detalles y verás la fusión! Esta competencia es posible gracias al apoyo del Presidente de **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Claudio Bañuelos**. Los Fuertes Puebla 2024 es una competencia oficial de la WCA por lo que todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [Reglamento](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/). ##### English **¡Welcome to Los Fuertes Puebla 2024!** Puebla, the city where greatness lies among volcanoes, is gearing up to welcome you to an upcoming competition and test your skills. How strong will you be able to become? This is a challenge against yourself! *Did you know...?* That triangle is considered the strongest geometric shape. When thinking about volcanoes, which is the category that comes to your mind? This is how Pyraminx represents different aspects of this competition. We're sure you weren't expecting such remarkable references between the name, location and our main event. And there's still more, take a look at the details and you'll see the fusion! This competition is possible thanks to the support of the President of **"Red Jóvenes X México Puebla"**, **Claudio Bañuelos**. Бул мелдештер QBERS командасынын колдоосу менен уюштурулууда. items.name: Oslo Open 2024
items.information: ## Informasjon Norsk: Velkommen til Oslo Open 2024! Alle er velkommen, enten du løser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minutter. Du trenger heller ingen tidligere erfaring med kubekonkurranser. Du melder deg på konkurransen online. Hvis du ikke har en WCA konto må du først lage en [her](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). Deltakeravgiften inkluderer lunsj på lørdag og søndag og snacks fredag kveld. Det blir salgsstand med salg av Oslo Open T-shirts og Nordicube selger kuber og stæsj. Lokalet har kiosk med salg av snacks, mat og drikke og T-shirt workshop der deltakere og besøkende kan trykke sin egen T-shirt. Velkommen til en helg i Oslo med ulike aktiviteter for kubeinteresserte! Det er kort vei til matbutikker og take-away-tilbud i nærområdet. Hvis du er medlem i Norges Kubeforbund får du 50 kr tilbake. Alle betaler først full påmeldingsavgift og så refunderer vi 50 kr til medlemmer av NKF. Klikk her for informasjon om[ medlemskap i NKF](https://kubing.no/OmOss). ## Information English: Welcome to Oslo Open 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior cube competition experience. You need to register for the competition online. If you don’t have a WCA account you can make one [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/users/sign_up). The participation fee includes lunch on Saturday and Sunday, as well as snacks on Friday evening. There will be a sales booth offering Oslo Open T-shirts and Nordicube selling cubes and accessories. The venue also has a kiosk selling snacks, food, and drinks, and a T-shirt workshop where participants and visitors can print their own T-shirt. Welcome to a weekend in Oslo with various activities for cube enthusiasts! There are several shops in the area selling food and take-away. If you are a member of Norges Kubeforbund we will refund 50 NOK. Everyone pays full price at first, and we will refund 50 NOK to members. For NKF membership, please visit [NKF's website kubing.no](https://kubing.no/OmOss)

Todo o lucro da competição será revertido para esta campanha. Para mais informações, consulte a aba [Campanha Beneficente](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Capivarinha2024#42610-campanha-beneficente). Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=OQ1vLrsJVqagiDna). É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, pois penalidades serão aplicadas rigorosamente de acordo com ele. O regulamento pode ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/). **English** It is in great excitement that we announce the first Capivarinha in history! In this competition we are collecting donations for philanthropic purposes, therefore, in addition to having fun, we can also help make a better world. All profit from the competition will be directed to that campaign. For more information, check the [Charitable Campaign](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Capivarinha2024#42610-campanha-beneficente) tab. Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://youtu.be/dZQiw5v8Bm0?si=Sq18haJ3WPk2AG82). It is very important that you know the regulations, since penalties will be applied precisely according to them. The regulations can be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).

REGISTRATION The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements, without fulfilling these requirements, the registration will not be accepted: ​ Register through the WCA website, pay in advance and send proof to the organizer via email (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) indicating the participant's full name. There will be a limit of 40 competitors. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) To underage competitors that will stay alone during the night period, it will be requested an express authorization of a parent or guardian authorizing the competitor's participation during said period. This is a 24 hour competition, therefore, be attentive to that. In case you're not able to stay the 24 hours, there is no need to, value your health and mental well-being.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdXB0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--12c29642a2fc1a7776803f30970bc62ffd4c6ceb/CuceiOpen_2%20(1).png) 10 años despues de la primera competencia en las instalaciones de CUCEI, **¡volvemos con el CUCEI Open 2024!** Esta es la 11va competencia oficial en el estado de Jalisco, en la cual buscamos conmemorar un poco sobre la historia del speedcubing en las tierras del tequila. Te invitamos a que disfrutes de las categorías favoritas de los speedcubers jalisciences en el 10mo aniversario de una de las competencias más importantes de Guadalajara. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/#2a) antes de la competencia. 10 years after the first copetition in CUCEI **we're back with CUCEI Open 2024!** This is the 11th official competition in Jalisco, in which we seek to commemorate the history of speedcubing in the land of tequila. We invite you to enjoy the favorite categories of the speedcubers from Jalisco in the 10th aniversary of one of the most important competitions in Guadalajara. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA regulations.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/#2a)

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0J4IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2702a39ca2f45a9b8086d0b54cb406344f0c2b05/logo_cubolympics.png) ### PORTUGUÊS Sejam bem-vindos ao **Rio Cubolympics 2024**! Será um prazer recebê-los. **Dicas:** - Chegue ao local da competição pelo menos **30 minutos** antes de **modalidade que participará**; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado; - Você é responsável pelo seu cubo e seus pertences, cuide deles. Não nos responsabilizamos por perda de cubos mágicos e outros pertences durante a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar para a equipe de organização e delegados. Mesmo que a nossa competição seja formada por alguns competidores experientes, sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. Procure se divertir bastante! ### ENGLISH Welcome to **Rio Cubolympics 2024**! It will be a pleasure to welcome you. **Tips:** - Arrive at the competition location at least **30 minutes** before **the category you will participate in**; - The cube you will compete with must be in good condition; - You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of cubes and other belongings during the competition; - If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organization team and delegates. Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we will always have room for new cubers. Have a lot of fun!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBangwIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--971a823d9d5dd23d1cd51053980e83ce5b04bdd4/logo%20ccp2024.png) Español Este 25 y 26 de mayo en la ciudad de Concepción, los speedcubers se reunirán para competir en una serie de desafíos de velocidad y habilidad. Únete a nosotros para un torneo de dos días lleno de giros, vueltas y momentos emocionantes mientras celebramos nuestra pasión por el cubo Rubik. ¡Prepárense para desafiar sus mentes, superar sus límites y descubrir quién será coronado como el campeón de Concepción al Cubo 2! ¡Nos vemos en la competencia! English This May 25 and 26 in the city of Concepción, speedcubers will meet to compete in a series of speed and skill challenges. Join us for a two-day tournament full of twists, turns, and exciting moments as we celebrate our passion for the Rubik's Cube. Get ready to challenge your minds, push your limits, and find out who will be crowned the champion of Concepción al Cubo 2! See you at the competition!

items.information: **Important Information for Participants**: **Location**: The competition will take place on the 5th floor of the Centre Square Mall. **Arrival Time**: Please ensure that you arrive at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts. items.name: Katerini Beach Open 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbFZ1IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--832ba1051dbfb958a61c53d310fdebb0b82e9442/image.png) Συνεχίζουμε τη συναρπαστική σειρά των διαγωνισμών για το 2024 με το 'Katerini Beach Open 2024', τον 4ο διαγωνισμό της χρονιάς. Αυτή τη φορά πηγαίνουμε βόρεια, στην ξακουστή παραλία της Κατερίνης, δίπλα στο κύμα! Στο συνεδριακό κέντρο του ξενοδοχείου Mediterranean Village θα συναντηθούμε με την φιλοδοξία να πραγματοποιηθεί ένα από τα μεγαλύτερα αν όχι το μεγαλύτερο έως τώρα OPEN της Ελλάδας! Σε ένα μοναδικό Σαββατοκύριακο, με άρωμα από το επερχόμενο ελληνικό καλοκαίρι, όλοι οι συμμετέχοντες θα απολαύσουν το πάθος τους για το cubing σε έναν ιδανικό προορισμό. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας (και τα μαγιό σας) και ελάτε να γιορτάσουμε μαζί την αγάπη για το cubing σε ένα αμιγώς ελληνικό τοπίο! Παρακαλούμε διαβάστε όλες τις καρτέλες για να βρείτε τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) We continue the exciting series of competitions for 2024 with the 'Katerini Beach Open 2024', the 4th competition of the year. This time we go north, to the famous beach of Katerini, by the sea! In the conference center of the Mediterranean Village hotel & SPA we will meet again with the ambition to hold one of the biggest, if not the biggest, OPEN in Greece! In a unique weekend, with the aroma of the upcoming Greek summer, all participants will enjoy their passion for cubing in an ideal destination. Grab your cubes (and your swimsuits) and come celebrate the love of cubing together in a purely Greek landscape! Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

Please note that neither 3x3 nor the other most popular events will be held at this competition. Regardless, everyone is of course welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. This is also an excellent opportunity to participate in the [Swedish FMC Championship](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2024) which is held the day after, and it's possible to compete in Örebro. items.information: [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce a new Cape Town competition for 2024. This comp will focus on the original cube, the **3x3x3**, and the varying ways to solve it - with **two hands, one-handed, blindfolded**, and in the **fewest moves**; and we will round out the events with some **2x2, 4x4,** and **Megaminx**. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make payment by buying a ticket. Please see **Registration Requirements** below." ### SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring 2 spectators with them. Please let us know if you need to accommodate more spectators. ### VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ### SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbU10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03db2d12875f7b21e073b29649b48a5bc813b0e2/image.png) A big thanks to [Speedcubes](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. ### LUCKY DRAW During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store. #### About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. In 2024, we are anticipating being able to host one competition every season in each of the cities of Cape Town, Johannesburg, and Durban, as well as other regular events in Pretoria, Bloemfontein, Limpopo, and more! If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to bring competitive speedcubing to the country, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact).

items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Trondheim Spring 2024! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 50kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSpring2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSpring2024#40829-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Trondheim Spring 2024! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 50 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. Егер сіз өтінім беріп, жарнаны төлеген болсаңыз, бірақ оны 2 жұмыс күні ішінде растамаған болса, дереу Ұйымдастырушыларға хабарласыңыз (демалыс күндерін есептемегенде). ##### Жарыс күні қатысушыда өзімен бірге жеке басын куәландыратын құжат болуы қажет. --- Please see our Instagram account (https://www.instagram.com/cubing.kz?igsh=MTlycGkxYnd5MnF6aA==). All information and news on the competition will be on our instagram. The organizers are not responsible for the loss of personal belongings. We strongly recommend using distinctive marks on the puzzles (Inside the cube or under the cover of the part), by which the owner can easily identify them. After paying the fee, your name will appear on the site. This means that your application has been accepted. If you have not paid the fee, you will receive an email reminding you to pay the fee to confirm your participation approximately 1 week before and immediately before the registration closes. Be sure to check your inbox and SPAM folder. If you do not pay the fee, your application will not be accepted. If you submitted an application and paid the fee, but did not confirm it within 2 working days, immediately contact the organizers (excluding weekends). ##### On the day of the competition, the participant must have an identity document with him.
