items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades. **ATENÇÃO:** Devido ao tamanho do local da competição, apenas um acompanhante será permitido por competidor. Façamos a competição ser possível para todos os competidores! --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events. **ATTENTION:** Due to the size of the competition's venue, only one guest will be allowed per competitor. Please do not bring more guests than the allowed quantity, let's make the competition possible for all competitors!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa1ZsIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3c6e9fe6551a0ccb8658afed67be40e057fe6ac2/Mololoa_logo.png) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al Mololoa Open 2024, la **segunda competencia oficial** en el hermoso estado de **Nayarit**!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic los días sábado 23 y domingo 24 de marzo de 2024. El Mololoa Open 2024 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de eventos. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. ###### English Welcome to Mololoa Open 2024, the **second official competition** in the beautiful state of **Nayarit**! This exciting and high-speed event will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, March 23, and Sunday, March 24, 2024. Mololoa Open 2024 will bring together cubers from across the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun. This competition is recognized as an official event by the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

items.name: DFW Megacomp 2024
items.information: This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. The registration process will prioritize new competitors for registration, and returning competitors will be accepted after. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. **New competitors registration will be accepted based on the following:** * The first 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * If greater than 25% of new competitors register, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If less than 25% of new competitors register before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. **Returning competitors may still register at any point during the registration period, but their registration will be accepted based on the following:** * The first 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * If 25% of spots are filled by new competitors, returning competitors will then be accepted on a first come, first serve basis. * If 25% of spots are not filled by new competitors by registration close two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. --- As the month of March is WCA Newcomer Month, 25% of the competitor limit will be reserved for first-time competitors or competitors who's first competition is in 2024. More information can be found on the [WCA Newcomer Month tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWMegacomp2024#36408-wca-newcomer-month). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGhZIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--392ac2f0728e8e69ef497494e33b38b6b56bc2f4/565a7d59-6eb6-4b27-af6a-ad3bd4963ec0.png) # ***NO OUTSIDE FOOD OR DRINK IS PERMITTED IN THE VENUE.*** - Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWMegacomp2024#35850-competitor-information) tab before the competition. - Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition. Please note that the [Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWMegacomp2024#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. Day 1 Events: 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, Clock, Pyraminx Day 2 Events: 3x3x3 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Megaminx, Square-1 This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/). To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
